question: After reading the paper "Controlling Text-to-Image Diffusion by Orthogonal Finetuning", I've learned a lot. Let me tell you everything I've learned.
reference_answer: The paper introduces Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT), a method for adapting text-to-image diffusion models to downstream tasks like subject-driven and controllable generation. The key idea is to use orthogonal transformations to finetune the model's weights, which provably preserves the hyperspherical energy between neurons. This helps maintain the semantic generation capabilities of the pretrained model. The paper also proposes a constrained version, COFT, for better stability. OFT is shown to be more efficient and effective than existing methods.
